name: Ophrasian War
definition: A cataclysmic conflict that lasted for forty years, reshaping the borders of Maltona and leaving the Boundless Vale scarred by wild magic.

name: Void Crystal
definition: A rare mineral found only in the deepest reaches of Blackreach; it hums with the frequency of the Ethereal Plane.

name: Behemoth
definition: A colossal, mutated fungal beast native to the deepest caverns of Maltona. Highly dangerous.
